open_points.subject: _normalize_staff_email
open_points.text: MUST strip, syntax-validate, and Unicode-casefold the address in that order while preserving dots and plus tags and performing no provider-specific rewrite.
open_points.other_text: It MUST also reject whitespace while preserving dots and plus tags.
open_points.question: Must leading and trailing whitespace be stripped and accepted, or cause IdentityInputRejected?

open_points.subject: change_staff_status
open_points.text: suspension or disabling revokes sessions/challenges and commits the status change plus one catalog audit atomically.
open_points.other_text: the outstanding challenges that entry also names have no persistence while that slice is deferred, so this function revokes none of them by declaration rather than by omission.
open_points.question: Must suspension and disabling revoke outstanding challenges, or revoke none of them?

open_points.subject: resolve_staff_session
open_points.text: MUST open its transaction with an explicit assignment, never as a context manager, and read only through tx.staff_access(): first the persisted session addressed by the identifier parsed out of the token, then the staff account that session names.
open_points.other_text: It MUST roll back exactly once immediately after the second of those two reads and mark the local open flag closed before it evaluates either result, so that a decidable rejection is never answered as a storage failure.
open_points.question: How can the first result remain unevaluated until after rollback when its staff_id must be evaluated to perform the required second read?

open_points.subject: resolve_staff_session
open_points.text: MUST parse the R17 selector, verify its secret hash, fixed expiry, revocation, active account, and verified email before returning StaffActorContext; any failure raises AuthenticationRejected.
open_points.other_text: It MUST roll back exactly once immediately after the second of those two reads and mark the local open flag closed before it evaluates either result, so that a decidable rejection is never answered as a storage failure.
open_points.question: When the parsed identifier names no persisted session, must the function raise AuthenticationRejected after the first read, or somehow perform the required second read and roll back only afterward?
